files.content: Step Tracker
files.description: Main UI for step logging and suggestion display.

files.content: const stepInput = document.getElementById('stepInput');const saveBtn = document.getElementById('saveBtn');const errorEl = document.getElementById('error');const suggestionEl = document.getElementById('suggestion');function getRecords(){return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('steps')||'[]')}function saveRecord(steps){const records = getRecords();records.push({date:new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],step_count:steps});localStorage.setItem('steps',JSON.stringify(records));updateSuggestion()}function updateSuggestion(){const records = getRecords();if(records.length<7){suggestionEl.innerText='Log more steps to get a 7-day average suggestion.';return}const last7 = records.slice(-7).reduce((sum,r)=>sum+r.step_count,0)/7;suggestionEl.innerText=`Your 7-day average is ${Math.round(last7)} steps. Keep it up!`;}saveBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{const val = parseInt(stepInput.value);if(isNaN(val)||val<0){errorEl.innerText='Please enter a valid non-negative integer.';return}errorEl.innerText='';saveRecord(val);stepInput.value='';});updateSuggestion();
files.description: Logic for input validation, LocalStorage persistence, and suggestion calculation.

setup_instructions: Open index.html in any modern web browser. No server setup is required.
implementation_notes: Used vanilla JavaScript for simplicity as per design requirements.
LocalStorage is used for persistence as specified in DD-01.
Input validation is performed client-side as per DD-02.
Suggestion engine calculates the average of the last 7 entries in the array.
Design decision: Frontend = HTML/CSS/JS (Simple, lightweight, and sufficient for a browser-based mobile-optimized interface.).
Design decision: Database = LocalStorage (Meets the V1 requirement for data persistence without the complexity of a backend server.).
Design decision: Using browser client-side storage (LocalStorage) for data persistence.
test_command: No automated test runner required for static HTML/JS; verify by opening in browser and checking console/UI behavior.
